# This file contains the setup effects for the tributaries in the game.
# The setup_tributaries_effect is invoked by on_game_start and should make calls to subsequent scripted effects.
# Sections are organized by top-suzerain title.
# Note that existing vassals (as established in title history) must be released and recreated into tributaries before
# they can have their own tributaries.

#I do not use Paradox's default setup as my map setup does not match theirs in any of the 3 bookmarks

setup_tributaries_effect = {

	# One combined effect per start date. Nomadic/herder tributaries and the tributaries of the
	# settled world are kept in separate sections inside each effect.

# $TRIBUTARY$ = the new tributary
# $SUZERAIN$ = their suzerain
# $WAR$ = determines if this was caused by war or agreement, yes or no
break_subject_contract_and_establish_tributary_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { liege != this }
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = independency
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = no
		}
		becomes_independent = {
			change = scope:change
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
	}
	start_tributary_interaction_effect = {
		SUZERAIN = $SUZERAIN$
		TRIBUTARY = $TRIBUTARY$
	}
}

	######################## HERDER TRIBUTARIES ########################
	# Each landed herder pays tribute to whoever rules the duchy his county lies in, or to a landed
	# count of that duchy when the ducal title is vacant. A liege-bound lord cannot hold tributaries,
	# so the chain above each herder is released level by level into the tribute web first - the
	# provincial kingdoms under the hegemony, then their frontier lords, then the herders beneath them.
	# Settled vassal lords are left in place and their herders pay the level above. Herders in
	# confederation lands and in lands with no ruler above them stay independent.
	# -- releases, highest level first --
	title:k_khazaria.holder ?= {
		save_scope_as = suzerain

		# K_PONTIC_STEPPE
		title:d_crimea.holder ?= {
			break_subject_contract_and_establish_tributary_effect = { SUZERAIN = scope:suzerain TRIBUTARY = this }
		}
	}

	######################## HERDER TRIBUTARIES ########################
	# Each landed herder pays tribute to whoever rules the duchy his county lies in, or to a landed
	# count of that duchy when the ducal title is vacant. A liege-bound lord cannot hold tributaries,
	# so the chain above each herder is released level by level into the tribute web first - the
	# provincial kingdoms under the hegemony, then their frontier lords, then the herders beneath them.
	# Settled vassal lords are left in place and their herders pay the level above. Herders in
	# confederation lands and in lands with no ruler above them stay independent.
	# -- releases, highest level first --

	######################## HERDER TRIBUTARIES ########################
	# Each landed herder pays tribute to whoever rules the duchy his county lies in, or to a landed
	# count of that duchy when the ducal title is vacant. A liege-bound lord cannot hold tributaries,
	# so the chain above each herder is released level by level into the tribute web first - the
	# provincial kingdoms under the hegemony, then their frontier lords, then the herders beneath them.
	# Settled vassal lords are left in place and their herders pay the level above. Herders in
	# confederation lands and in lands with no ruler above them stay independent.
	# -- releases, highest level first --
	title:k_caspian_steppe.holder ?= {
		save_scope_as = suzerain

	######################## HERDER TRIBUTARIES ########################
	# Each landed herder pays tribute to whoever rules the duchy his county lies in, or to a landed
	# count of that duchy when the ducal title is vacant. A liege-bound lord cannot hold tributaries,
	# so the chain above each herder is released level by level into the tribute web first - the
	# provincial kingdoms under the hegemony, then their frontier lords, then the herders beneath them.
	# Settled vassal lords are left in place and their herders pay the level above. Herders in
	# confederation lands and in lands with no ruler above them stay independent.
	# -- releases, highest level first --

	# count of that duchy when the ducal title is vacant. A liege-bound lord cannot hold tributaries,
	# so the chain above each herder is released level by level into the tribute web first - the

	######################## HERDER TRIBUTARIES ########################
	# Each landed herder pays tribute to whoever rules the duchy his county lies in, or to a landed
	# count of that duchy when the ducal title is vacant. A liege-bound lord cannot hold tributaries,
	# so the chain above each herder is released level by level into the tribute web first - the
	# provincial kingdoms under the hegemony, then their frontier lords, then the herders beneath them.
	# Settled vassal lords are left in place and their herders pay the level above. Herders in
	# confederation lands and in lands with no ruler above them stay independent.
	# -- releases, highest level first --

	######################## HERDER TRIBUTARIES ########################
	# Each landed herder pays tribute to whoever rules the duchy his county lies in, or to a landed
	# count of that duchy when the ducal title is vacant. A liege-bound lord cannot hold tributaries,
	# so the chain above each herder is released level by level into the tribute web first - the
	# provincial kingdoms under the hegemony, then their frontier lords, then the herders beneath them.
	# Settled vassal lords are left in place and their herders pay the level above. Herders in
	# confederation lands and in lands with no ruler above them stay independent.
	# -- releases, highest level first --

	######################## HERDER TRIBUTARIES ########################
	# Each landed herder pays tribute to whoever rules the duchy his county lies in, or to a landed
	# count of that duchy when the ducal title is vacant. A liege-bound lord cannot hold tributaries,
	# so the chain above each herder is released level by level into the tribute web first - the
	# provincial kingdoms under the hegemony, then their frontier lords, then the herders beneath them.
	# Settled vassal lords are left in place and their herders pay the level above. Herders in
	# confederation lands and in lands with no ruler above them stay independent.
	# -- releases, highest level first --
	title:k_caspian_steppe.holder ?= {
		save_scope_as = suzerain
